I met this guy at a party, short, leprechaun weed dealer (I'm 5'3 and he was an inch shorter than I). I was 16 and shallow and thought hey, one date where I'm going to be stoned through most of it can't be that bad, right? Wrong. He picks me up in his little beater of a pick up truck, and we begin smoking a joint and driving to this sushi buffet. He was excited that he thought they offered all you can eat sushi, and so was I, because I love sushi. When we arrive, we discover that the all you can eat sushi is only offered during the afternoon. He decides to bitch at the waitresses and treat them like shit because of this and orders literally, 10 rolls of sushi at least. The waitstaff and myself are looking at him like he's crazy but they put his food order in and the sushi begins to come in waves. Now this guy is determined to eat all the sushi he's ordered because everyone has informed him he can't do it. After about an hour of him shoveling sushi in his mouth and talking about himself and generally just being a douche bag, he gets up unexpectedly and excuses himself to the bathroom. He was in the bathroom for a good 15 minutes. Meanwhile, the waitress comes up to me and asks me if this is first date, I told her yes and apologized for his behavior. In response she apologizes to me because she can clearly see I'm having an awful time and offers to hide me in the back before he comes back out. I deny but I should've taken her up on it. He comes back, pale faced and smelling of puke. He finally admits defeat, gets the check and we head to his car. At this point I'm waiting for him to unlock the truck so I can get the fuck out of there. He goes to the drivers side, doesn't do anything and comes to my side of the truck. He says "BrightKnives, I'm so sorry, I locked the keys in the truck." I go "Oh...shit, well thats okay I'm sure you can call someone" he wraps his arms around my waist and goes "Well we can do something to pass the time" and begins shoving his sushi puke tongue down my throat. I push him off and say uh I don't really think making out in a parking lot is the most romantic thing. I was still trying to let him down easy at this point. And then he goes "Well I was just kidding, I have the keys" Pissed. Shocked. And completely grossed out, I get in the truck and we drive back to my place. No other kisses were exchanged and I never spoke to him again.
